QuestInfo.name: Chiefs of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Find Athena Pierce, the Bowman Job Instructor, and see what advice she has.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce sent you to the Chief's Residence in El Nath to become an even stronger Bowman.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Rene, the Bowman Elder, at the Chief's Residence.
